The '''Banai house''' was located in [[Espa Heights]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It had one large dome and three smaller ones arranged in a diamond around a central courtyard.<ref name="TG" />

[[Kitster Chanchani Banai]] lived in the house with his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Tamora Spice]], and children [[Elly Banai|Elly]] and [[Ji Banai|Ji]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], during an [[Mission to Tatooine (Killik Twilight)|incident]] involving [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] member [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and her companions, the group approached the Banai household in search of Kitster.<ref name="TG" />
